accept.name: one-byte-minimum-frame
accept.note: Smallest legal frame: 80-byte header plus one payload byte.

accept.name: short-last-frame
accept.note: QR 22-H byte capacity (439); 2 full slices of 359 bytes then 282.

accept.name: exact-fit-v40-l
accept.note: Largest QR byte capacity (40-L, 2953); exactly one full frame.

accept.name: one-byte-overflow-v40-l
accept.note: One byte over a full 40-L frame: second frame carries a 1-byte payload.

accept.name: nul-and-high-bytes
accept.note: NUL, CR/LF and invalid UTF-8 sequences must survive byte mode untouched.

accept.name: ots-like-receipt
accept.note: OTS magic prefix with synthetic body; QR 11-M byte capacity (251).

reject.name: missing-frame
reject.rule: Every index below the frame count must be present.

reject.name: conflicting-duplicate
reject.rule: Duplicate indices must carry identical payloads.

reject.name: payload-bit-flip
reject.rule: Reassembled bytes must match the SHA-256 in the header.

reject.name: compression-1
reject.rule: Compression values other than 0 are rejected.

reject.name: index-equals-count
reject.rule: Frame index must be less than the count.

reject.name: encoded-differs
reject.rule: Encoded length must equal original length in v1.

reject.name: payload-length-mismatch
reject.rule: Payload length must equal the actual trailing byte count.

reject.name: frame-over-2953
reject.rule: A frame cannot exceed the largest QR byte capacity (2953 bytes).

reject.name: mixed-certificates
reject.rule: Frames of different proofs must not be combined.

reject.name: proof-id-mismatch
reject.rule: The 16-byte proof identifier must match the recomputed domain-separated hash.

reject.name: original-length-mismatch
reject.rule: Reassembled byte count must equal the declared original and encoded length.
